explanation.text:
Those who are fit for communion with God may be known by a conformity to His law, which is illustrated in various important particulars. (Psa 15:1-5)

abide--or, "sojourn" (compare Psa 5:4), where it means under God's protection here, as (Psa 23:6, Psa 27:4, Psa 27:6) communion.

tabernacle--seat of the ark (Sa2 6:17), the symbol of God's presence.

holy hill--(Compare Psa 2:6).

headings.title: Who May Dwell on Your Holy Mountain?

bsb.title: A Psalm of David.
bsb.text: O LORD, who may abide in Your tent? Who may dwell on Your holy mountain?

1.interlinear: LORD/H3068 who shall abide/H1481 in thy tabernacle/H168 who shall dwell/H7931 in thy holy/H6944 hill/H2022

explanation.text:
walketh--(Compare Psa 1:1).

uprightly--in a complete manner, as to all parts of conduct (Gen 17:1), not as to degree.

worketh--or, "does."

righteousness--what is right.

in his heart--sincerely (Pro 23:7).

bsb.text: He who walks with integrity and practices righteousness, who speaks the truth from his heart,

2.interlinear: He that walketh/H1980 uprightly/H8549 and worketh/H6466 righteousness/H6664 and speaketh/H1696 the truth/H571 in his heart/H3824

explanation.text: He neither slanders nor spreads slander.

bsb.text: who has no slander on his tongue, who does no harm to his neighbor, who casts no scorn on his friend,

explanation.text:
Love and hate are regulated by a regard to God.

sweareth . . . hurt--or what so results (compare Lev 5:4).

bsb.text: who despises the vile but honors those who fear the LORD, who does not revise a costly oath,

4.interlinear: In whose eyes/H5869 a vile person/H3988 is contemned/H959 but he honoureth/H3513 them that fear/H3373 the LORD/H3068 *He *that sweareth/H7650 to *his *own hurt/H7489 and changeth/H4171 not

explanation.text:
(Compare Lev 25:37; Deu 23:19-20).

usury is derived from a verb meaning "to bite." All gains made by the wrongful loss of others are forbidden.

taketh reward, etc.--The innocent would not otherwise be condemned (compare Exo 23:8; Deu 16:19). Bribery of all sorts is denounced.

doeth these, etc.--Such persons admitted to God's presence and favor shall never be moved (Psa 10:6; Psa 13:5).
